---
title: "Send us a question"
subtitle: "Found something strange in Neuroglancer? Send us the link and your question. A scientist who works in that data will write back."

```{=html}
<div class="form-embed">
<iframe title="Submission form for questions and finds" loading="lazy" data-form-url="{{< var form_url >}}">Loading the form…</iframe>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var iframe = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling.querySelector("iframe");
  var url = new URL(iframe.dataset.formUrl);
  url.searchParams.set("embedded", "true");
  iframe.src = url.toString();
})();
</script>
```
